en:
PWM Out

Introduction

The pwm_out class is used to control PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) output on a VEX V5 3-Wire port. It allows devices to send variable-width pulse signals to compatible 3-Wire components.

Class Constructors

pwm_out(
  triport::port &port );

Class Destructor

Destroys the pwm_out object and releases associated resources.

~pwm_out();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
port triport::port & The 3-Wire Port the PWM output is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X, where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A).

Example

// Create the pwm_out instance on 3-Wire Port A
pwm_out pwm = pwm_out(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

Member Functions

The pwm_out class includes the following member functions:

  • state — Sets the state of the PWM output.

Before calling any pwm_out member functions, a pwm_out instance must be created, as shown below:

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
PWM configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the pwm_out instance on 3-Wire Port A
pwm_out pwm = pwm_out(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

state

Sets the state of the PWM output to a specified value.

Available Functions

void state(
  int32_t      value,
  percentUnits units );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
value int32_t The new value to set for PWM output, from -100 to +100 percent.
units percentUnits The unit used to represent the PWM value: percent / pct — percent

Return Values

This function does not return a value.

Notes

  • The PWM output value ranges from -100 to +100 percent.

  • The only valid unit for PWM output is percent.

    Examples

// Set the PWM Output to 50%
pwm.state(50, percent);

// Set the PWM Output to -75%
pwm.state(-75, percent);
zh:
PWM 输出

概述

pwm_out类用于控制 VEX V5 三线端口上的 PWM（脉冲宽度调制）输出。它允许设备向兼容的 3 线组件发送可变宽度脉冲信号。

构造函数

pwm_out(
  triport::port &port );

析构函数

销毁pwm_out对象并释放关联资源。

~pwm_out();

参数

参数 类型 说明
port triport::port & PWM 输出连接的三线端口，写作Brain.ThreeWirePort.X或ExpanderName.X，其中X为端口号（例如Brain.ThreeWirePort.A或Expander1.A）。

示例

// Create the pwm_out instance on 3-Wire Port A
pwm_out pwm = pwm_out(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

成员函数

pwm_out类包含以下成员函数：

  • state— 设置 PWM 输出的状态。

在调用任何pwm_out成员函数之前，必须创建一个pwm_out实例，如下所示：

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
PWM configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the pwm_out instance on 3-Wire Port A
pwm_out pwm = pwm_out(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

state

将 PWM 输出的状态设置为指定值。

函数重载

void state(
  int32_t      value,
  percentUnits units );

参数

参数 类型 说明
value int32_t 为 PWM 输出设置的新值，从 -100% 到 +100%。
units percentUnits 用于表示 PWM 值的单位：percent/pct— 百分比

返回值

此函数无返回值。

说明与注意事项

  • PWM 输出值范围为 -100% 至 +100%。

  • PWM 输出的唯一有效单位是percent。

    示例

// Set the PWM Output to 50%
pwm.state(50, percent);

// Set the PWM Output to -75%
pwm.state(-75, percent);
